name: September 2019 Historic Patna Catastrophic Flooding
classification: Catastrophic Urban Inundation and Drainage Outfall Failure
impact_summary: Unprecedented 322.8mm extreme downpour overwhelmed Patna municipal sump houses and outfalls into the Punpun/Ganga; extensive inundation (1.5-2.5m) in Rajendra Nagar, Kankarbagh, Saidpur, and 7 other chronic depression basins paralyzing the city for days.
source_reference: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) / Bihar State Disaster Management Authority (BSDMA) Flood Audit & Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus reanalysis)

name: September 2024 Bihar Late-Season Heavy Rain & Inundation Episode
classification: Moderate to High Late-Season Urban Inundation Episode
impact_summary: Intense late-monsoon storm produced 80.3mm rainfall causing documented waterlogging in Patna's chronic low-lying sump depressions (Rajendra Nagar, Saidpur, Kankarbagh); official case study by IMD Meteorological Centre Patna.
source_reference: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / MC Patna Special Bulletin ('An intense late-season spell of heavy rainfall and associated flooding over Bihar during 26–29 September 2024') & Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus reanalysis)

name: Cyclone Michaung Heavy Inundation
impact_summary: Extensive neighborhood inundation across South and Central Chennai; water depths between 1.5m to 2.5m in Velachery, Madipakkam, and Tambaram; city paralyzed for over 72 hours.
source_reference: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus) & India Meteorological Department (IMD) Special Monsoon Bulletin

name: November 2021 Deep Depression Inundation
classification: Moderate to High Flash Inundation Event
impact_summary: Sudden intense overnight rainfall caused severe flash waterlogging; all railway underpasses in North Chennai closed; over 500 arterial roads inundated.
source_reference: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus) & GCC Monsoon Control Room Daily Situation Reports
